Implemented the RS274 simulator as a CLI in `output/main.py` (stdlib-only, Python 3.11+), reading `docs/RS274NGC.md` plus `docs/Clarifications.md` as normative.

Key updates in this iteration:
- Fixed RS274 parameter index limits for `#...` reads/writes to `1..5399` per spec (`output/expression.py`, `output/gcode_parser.py`).
- Wired cutter radius compensation into execution for `G0/G1/G2/G3`:
  - CRC linear motion now interprets X/Y as contour endpoints, executes compensated tool-tip motion, inserts convex-corner rounding arcs for straight moves, and raises the spec’s concave-corner error (`output/simulator.py`).
  - CRC straight-move multi-submotions apportion `G93` inverse-time duration across the corner-arc + straight segment as required.
- Added minimal `O`-word parsing so “pure O-word control flow” lines can be accepted as no-ops (`output/gcode_parser.py`).

Entrypoint remains runnable as `python output/main.py --input <file> --output <json> ...`.

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.
